# Third-party animation sources

This directory vendors commercially permitted Remotion animation source for LocalFeed Motion Studio.

| Source | Path | License | Notes |
|--------|------|---------|-------|
| [lifeprompt-team/remotion-scenes](https://github.com/lifeprompt-team/remotion-scenes) | `lifeprompt-remotion-scenes/` | MIT | Accent/dark tokens remapped to LocalFeed brand |
| [reactvideoeditor/remotion-templates](https://github.com/reactvideoeditor/remotion-templates) | `rve-remotion-templates/` | MIT | Standalone templates; attribution appreciated |
| [vungods/SwiftClip](https://github.com/vungods/SwiftClip) | `swiftclip/` | MIT | Production template set |

Not imported (license / suitability):
- `ali-abassi/remotion-templates` — no LICENSE file (all rights reserved by default)
- `Theme3DGlassThreeJS` from remotion-scenes — requires Three.js runtime (deferred)

Preserve LICENSE files when redistributing.
